title: Systems and methods for determining asset importance in security risk management
related_application_signals: continuation family includes US17/320,997 and US17/039,675
related grants include US11032244B2 and US11949655B2

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.

classification_signals: G06F16/951 web or network information retrieval
publicly_described_functional_concepts: receiving multiple datasets that describe computer-network assets associated with an entity
deriving input features from signals such as DNS lookup frequency, application or website configuration, authentication-certificate metadata, and other asset context
computing an importance value or ranking for hosts or IP addresses using one or more weighted input signals
presenting ranked asset importance to support security-risk prioritization
using multiple source types to reduce reliance on any single indicator of asset significance

scope_model.analysis_loop: ingest authorized asset and telemetry records -> normalize source-specific features -> preserve provenance and source quality -> compute independently designed asset-importance scores -> attach confidence and contributing factors -> present ranked assets for analyst review -> use rankings to prioritize defensive assessment and remediation -> record outcomes for calibration
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: separate asset identity from importance score and from vulnerability severity
make each contributing signal explainable and provenance-linked
normalize heterogeneous telemetry before weighting or aggregation
version scoring formulas and thresholds so rankings are reproducible
include confidence and missing-data indicators rather than treating scores as ground truth
use rankings to prioritize authorized defensive work rather than to enable intrusion or exploitation
require analyst review before consequential remediation or access changes
support organization-specific weights through governed configuration rather than hidden model behavior

independent_claim_themes: ranking importance of entity-associated hosts or IP addresses
deriving ranking inputs from multiple data sources such as DNS activity, configuration signals, or certificate information
combining or weighting multiple input signals to determine asset importance
using resulting rankings in security or asset-management workflows
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: Patent scope depends on controlling claims, prosecution history, legal status, and jurisdiction. This record is an engineering research abstraction only.

design_divergence_defaults: use independently selected asset features and scoring functions
derive weights from documented organizational risk objectives and validation data
separate ranking from vulnerability detection and remediation execution
store score explanations, feature provenance, confidence, and model version for every result
avoid copying patent figures, claim wording, or exact example weight combinations
